name: Odix Pay Corporate
summary: A virtual card solution designed for teams with high daily spending limits and seamless mobile wallet integration.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required
Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Odix Pay Corporate charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is US$5.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Odix Pay Corporate?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the Odix Pay Corporate require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
